types.name: Blob
docs: An erasure-coded payload (PDA `["blob", owner, root]`), see
docs/blob-protocol.md.  One account per blob whatever its size: `root`
commits to every shard, nodes hold one shard each and are paid per epoch
once they prove they still have it.

fields.name: root
docs: Merkle root over the shard roots

fields.name: needs_holders
docs: Some slot is vacant and the blob has not expired (nodes filter on it)

fields.name: data_shards
docs: Shards needed to reconstruct (`k`)

fields.name: total_shards
docs: Shards stored (`n = k + m`)

fields.name: held
docs: Slots with a holder

fields.name: shard_size
docs: Bytes per shard, a multiple of SEGMENT_SIZE

fields.name: payload_size
docs: Encrypted payload bytes (informative)

fields.name: reward_per_shard_epoch
docs: Escrowed reward of one shard slot for one epoch

types.name: ChallengeVoided
docs: No block was produced inside the challenge window: nobody could answer

types.name: Chunk
docs: One chunk of encrypted data (PDA `["chunk", owner, content_hash]`).
The bytes never live in account state.  A *ledger* chunk is written in
segments carried by `write_segment` instruction data, so the ledger holds
it while it is Hot.  A *direct* chunk (`segment_size == 0`) is sent by the
uploader straight to replicators, which check it against `content_hash`:
no segment transactions at all.  The account keeps the commitment
(sha256), the segment bitmap, the replicas that confirmed and the escrowed
rewards, and closes itself (rent back to the owner) once every replica
confirmed.

fields.name: content_hash
docs: sha256 of the full chunk; also the PDA seed

fields.name: writer
docs: Key allowed to write segments (the owner or a session key)

fields.name: needs_replicas
docs: Complete, not reclaimed and still short of replicas (replicators filter on it)

fields.name: reward_per_replica
docs: Lamports escrowed in this account for each replica

fields.name: segments
docs: Bit `i` is set once segment `i` is in the ledger

fields.name: replicators
docs: Replicators that confirmed, in order

types.name: Config
docs: Protocol settings (PDA `["config"]`).

fields.name: treasury
docs: Receives the protocol share of every upload

fields.name: base_fee_per_replica
docs: Flat fee per requested replica, in lamports (covers the confirmation)

fields.name: price_per_mib
docs: Price per MiB per requested replica, in lamports (disk + bandwidth),
charged pro rata to the byte

fields.name: protocol_fee_bps
docs: Share of each upload kept by the protocol, in basis points

fields.name: replication_threshold_pct
docs: Percentage of the requested replicas that turns a chunk Cool

fields.name: replication_window
docs: Seconds replicators have before the uploader can reclaim empty slots

fields.name: epoch_seconds
docs: Blob storage is prepaid per epoch of this many seconds

fields.name: price_per_mib_epoch
docs: Lamports per MiB of shard per epoch, charged pro rata to the byte

fields.name: challenge_window_slots
docs: Slots a holder has to answer a challenge after its target slot

fields.name: challenge_cooldown
docs: Seconds between two challenges of the same shard slot

fields.name: challenger_bounty_bps
docs: Share of forfeited rewards paid to whoever reports a failed challenge

types.name: Grant
docs: A reader's copy of a record (PDA `["grant", record, viewer]`), sealed to
the viewer's encryption key.

types.name: Identity
docs: Public X25519 key other users seal data to (PDA `["identity", user]`).

fields.name: record_nonce
docs: Seeds the next record address of this user

fields.name: root
docs: Merkle root over the shard roots (docs/blob-protocol.md §2)

fields.name: data_shards
docs: Shards needed to reconstruct (`k`)

fields.name: total_shards
docs: Shards stored (`n = k + m`)

fields.name: shard_size
docs: Bytes per shard, a multiple of SEGMENT_SIZE

fields.name: payload_size
docs: Encrypted payload bytes (informative)

fields.name: epochs
docs: Storage prepaid, in epochs of `config.epoch_seconds`

fields.name: max_fee
docs: Abort if the quote is above this many lamports

fields.name: content_hash
docs: sha256 of the full chunk

fields.name: size
docs: Chunk length in bytes

fields.name: segment_size
docs: Bytes per `write_segment` (the last one may be shorter); 0 = direct
chunk: the uploader sends the bytes straight to replicators

fields.name: writer
docs: Key allowed to write the segments (the owner or a session key)

fields.name: max_fee
docs: Abort if the quote is above this many lamports

types.name: Record
docs: Encrypted record (PDA `["record", owner, nonce]`).  `content` is sealed
to the owner's encryption key; readers get their own copy in a Grant.

fields.name: schema
docs: Unencrypted schema hint, e.g. `soladb.file.v2`

types.name: Replicator
docs: Storage node approved by the admin (PDA `["replicator", authority]`).

fields.name: endpoint
docs: HTTP endpoint that serves `/chunk/:id/data`

types.name: ShardSlot
docs: One erasure-coded shard position of a blob

fields.name: holder
docs: Replicator holding the shard; the default key = vacant

fields.name: proven_at
docs: Last successful storage proof (or the confirmation)

fields.name: claimed_until
docs: Rewards are paid up to this time

fields.name: challenge_slot
docs: Slot whose hash picks the challenged segment; 0 = no open challenge

fields.name: challenge_deadline
docs: Last slot to answer the open challenge
